policy: Exact EVSE-level evidence only. The AFIR/Mobilithek-derived snapshot for Electra München - La Selva publishes 0.58 EUR/kWh ad-hoc with no start or blocking fee for the six listed DE*ELD EVSEs. This must not be promoted to a Germany-wide fallback because Electra's official tariff help page dated 2026-07-01 currently states 0.54 EUR/kWh for Electra App/Autocharge and 0.69 EUR/kWh for bank-card payment in Germany, while Electra also documents a conditional DC occupancy fee for app users (0.40 EUR/min after a 5-minute grace period only when SOC is at least 80% and the station is congested). The channel/AFIR semantic mismatch must be resolved before operator-wide completion; other DE*ELD EVSEs remain unpriced unless independently evidenced.
sourceSemantics: e-Stations.de identifies the station feed as Mobilithek (German National Access Point, DATEX II), supplied by Eco-Movement under AFIR Art. 20 open-data publication.
